title: About Kristu Jayanti University
keywords: about overview profile university introduction what is kristu jayanti kju deemed
text: Kristu Jayanti (Deemed to be University) is in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It is a private, co-educational, self-financing institution, recognised as a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956 (notification dated 8 July 2025). The college was established on 6 September 1999 and is run by the Kristu Jayanti Trust, Bengaluru, under the Carmelites of Mary Immaculate (CMI), St. Joseph CMI Province, Kottayam. It has about 15,758 students, 800+ teaching staff, 200+ administrative staff and 126+ support staff. The university has 17 major departments, 32 UG, 23 PG and 17 PhD programmes (the website also says 100+ UG, PG and doctoral courses, and 24 PhD disciplines).

text: Admission steps: 1) Register by filling in the online application; 2) Upload documents; 3) Screening by entrance test or interview; 4) Pay admission fees; 5) Receive the admission letter. title: Examination Pattern, Semesters and Assessment

text: UG 3-year: 6 semesters; UG Honours 4-year: 8 semesters; Honours Law: 10 semesters; PG: 4 semesters; MBA: 6 trimesters. Each semester has 90 working days. Assessment is Formative (FA, internal) plus Summative (SA, end semester). UG 2024-27 batch: FA 20%, SA 80%. UG 2025-28 and 2026-29 batches: generally FA 40%, SA 60%. PG 2025-27 and 2026-28: 3-4 credit theory FA 40, SA 60. LLB 2024-29: FA 40, SA 60. Mid-term, assignments, class participation and KJLMS quizzes make up FA.
